The synthesis is already complete and saved — all three background agents (WI-019–025 sensitivity/float32, WI-018 mapping traps + commit pin, admissible cost-accuracy sources) finished last turn, and none stalled, so no re-derivation was needed. The artifact on disk has all seven sections A–G (267 lines, 28.6 KB), every claim cited to a file path.

What it contains:

- **(A)** Three-tier parity table + per-account deviations (float32 floor ~1e-7, formula-iso ~1e-8, oracle 1e-9), SV-025/026/028.
- **(B)** The WI-025 float32 finding with the exactness-proof numbers — the basis for a ~1e-6 per-account bar.
- **(C)** Complete 14-trap mapping inventory, each marked asserted-in-code vs documented.
- **(D)** The −31% gap itemized account-by-account (CAS22 tail ~$1.09B, CAS40/50/60, CAS70/80) — the criterion-3 boundary.
- **(E)** The full WI-018→025 LCOE re-baseline sequence, with the orchestrator's remembered attribution corrected.
- **(F)** Admissibly-sourced AACE Class 5 bands (arXiv 2602.19389 Table 3).
- **(G)** Eight spec-stage flags, including the surfaced G-8 premise conflict (the standing "comparison JSON must diff empty" bar collides with Items 3–4) left for the owner, not resolved.
